entries.title: Rohan Iyer Work Product IP retention
entries.summary: The contractor, Rohan Iyer, retains ownership of all intellectual property rights in the Work Product (dashboards, reports, data models, etc.) created during the performance of services, granting AtliQ only a non-exclusive license.
entries.quote: The Contractor retains ownership of all intellectual property rights in the Work Product and in any pre-existing materials, components and templates of the Contractor.

relatedClauses.quote: In this Clause, "Work Product" means all dashboards, reports, data models, DAX measures, Power Query scripts, visual templates, documentation and other materials created by the Contractor in performing the Services.

The Contractor grants AtliQ a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, worldwide licence to use, copy, modify and deploy the Work Product for the purposes of AtliQ's business, including for delivery to AtliQ's clients.

entries.notes: The contractor retains full ownership of deliverables. AtliQ is granted only a non-exclusive, perpetual license to use, modify, and deploy them.
